title: Billboard Latin Music Week 2026 Photo Booth: Anuel AA, Becky G, Maluma & More
summary: See some of the photo booth gems captured backstage throughout the week.
contentText:
Billboard Latin Music Week 2026 brought some of the biggest Latin music stars to Miami for a weeklong conference, including Anuel AA, Becky G, Fuerza Regida, Kany García, Lali, Maluma, Mau & Ricky, and many more. The artists – who spoke at panels and/or performed at showcases – also posed for Billboard ’s photo booth.

Among the artists sitting for Icon or Superstar Q&As were Puerto Rican singer-songwriter Kany García, música mexicana powerhouse Fuerza Regida, Colombian superstar Maluma, Mexican-American singer and actress Becky G, Panamanian legend Rubén Blades and Cuban-American global megastar Pitbull.

Meanwhile, Venezuelan trippy-pop band Rawayana shared the story behind their touring success in a panel presented by Live Nation, along with Latin Power Players Executive of the Year Hans Schafer; married couples Jessi Uribe and Paola Jara, and Jay Wheeler and Zhamira, joined together on stage for a conversation about Love & Music; and Ana Mena, Aria Vega, Greeicy, LALI, Lola Indigo and RaiNao were the stars of the Women’s Panel: Global Rising.

This year’s Billboard En Vivo showcases where in charge of Fuerza Regida (Oct. 20) and Jay Wheeler and Zhamira (Oct. 21). Speakers also included Bebeshito, Carlos Rivera, Clave Especial, Grupo Frontera, Grupo Niche, Quevedo, Ryan Castro and more.

Latin Music Week also coincided with the 2026 Billboard Latin Music Awards, which aired Thursday, Oct. 22, on Telemundo and Peacock. During the ceremony, Cristian Castro, Fuerza Regida, Rosalía and Rubén Blades received special awards, while Fuerza Regida was the biggest winner with eight trophies.
